segments.text: Hello there.
I'm Josue. I'm a web designer and developer from New Zealand.
I work freelance. I jump into agencies and help them out
or work directly with, my own clients as well.
I'm making a new series called Webdune Diaries. Webdune
is the trading name of the business
I work under. it's just me. It's nothing fancy.
Webdune Diaries is all about what goes on behind the scenes. I feel like when I started, there wasn't many people,
talking transparently about the difficulties
of being a freelancer, especially in
the web world.
so I wanted to, wanna start a series talking about that sort of stuff, get things off my chest. Problem shared is a problem halved, so you know, taxes and GST
and upcoming bills
and those moments of,
feast and famine. That happens a lot with freelancing, those famine moments are tough, like so many times I wanted to just fully,
quit. So it'll be interesting to talk more about that sort of stuff and then also talk about the stuff I've learned along the way. My notes are over here.
it says season one, this is gonna be broken down into seasons,
just to keep like a goal per season, keep some sort of continuity.

the first season is about me wanting to build a website for Fox Stevenson. He's a favourite, music artist of mine. I'd love to upgrade his website big time, and bring way more personality to it. The last talking point is, I don't wanna keep this too long,
tomorrow's episode, I'm gonna try to do them daily, tomorrow's is about where I'm actually at, what's going on in my business.
yeah, see you tomorrow.
